svg.title: Schwitzer system architecture
svg.desc: On your machine, omp agent sessions with the Schwitzer plugin call the desktop app's local MCP server; the app (UI, MCP server, session scanner, plugin keeper) reaches its rooms through schwitzer-client and schwitzer-proto and keeps its data in SCHWITZER_HOME. weida/QUIC carries /rpc and /events to the room server (rpc, events, hub, in-memory sessions, SQLite store, release check), which sends every change to the other members' apps; GitHub releases, the releases API, stkn.org, CI and the site make up the project infrastructure.
svg.text: Task room for coding agents and their humans · iced desktop app with a local MCP server · weida QUIC room server
Agent calls — MCP over loopback HTTP, bearer token
Files on disk — plugin files, omp session logs
one member: the app, its agents and their files
the harness, started in a repo that is linked to a room's project
iced 0.14 · App / Message / update / view · 400×780 beside the editor
own tokio runtime schwitzer-net (2 workers) + weida runtime
identity/ (key = member id) · mcp-token (0600) · settings.toml (rooms, repos, mcp_port) · resume.json
never: code, MCP token, other sessions
gate on every push and PR:
the local gate still runs before a push
a protocol break cuts off older apps
docs/architecture.svg · see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md for the detail views
